s9.title: 2026 Turret Vs Fixed Debate - Technical, post 221

bet.text: A big, wide hopper that picks up as many balls as possible, about 115, on a robot that only crosses the bump.

demand.text: Fuel volume: the team wanted to fill the hopper to its maximum so it could shoot as many balls as possible.

cycle.text: The wide intake takes balls rather than pushing them, the robot crosses the bump, and a four-wide shooter empties the hopper.
A post that says it is from 2481 reports that 2481 and 1678 screened for each other, and one dump each per period was enough with a combined 160 or more balls, though defense cost a few seconds.

fallback.text: When a defender sits on the bump, partners set picks to knock it out of the way.

gave_up.text: Crossing only the bump invites a defender there, and the weight of the balls made the team gear the drive low.
An analyst of a week 3 match says one defender, and fuel left along the far walls, kept 2481 without a full hopper for about 40 seconds.

changed.text: The first hopper, of aluminium angle, had durability trouble, caught on things and racked, so it was rebuilt mostly in tube. The intake motor stalled, so a second was added. Shooter side plates and brackets were made heavier after breaking, and a linear actuator replaced a pneumatic piston.

outcome.text: 44-8-0 in official play; won the Milstein division; pick 1 of the Milstein alliance on Einstein; ranked 15 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 297.50, Milstein).
